newsitem.title: UK: ARA BUNKERS GAIN $1, HAMBURG FLAT.
newsitem.headline: ARA BUNKERS GAIN $1, HAMBURG FLAT.

text.p: ARA bunker prices were slightly firmer on Wednesday and traders in the region said demand for product was good.
Standard 380 cst bunkers were valued at around $98.50 a tonne fob ARA, while 180 cst was seen around $5 higher.
"It is slightly up and there is good bunker demand," one trader said.
Hamburg bunker fuel prices were flat. "It is little changed and the market is quiet," one trader said.
He assessed prices for 380 cst at $100-$101, 180 cst at $105/$107, diesel at $165/$168 and gas oil up at $180,$183.
The distillates were slightly softer in line with a weaker IPE futures screen.
